annotations.title: Screen up to 25 names against EU, UN, UK and US sanctions (paid)

description: Use when screening a list of people or companies at once (up to 25 per call, 0.0012 USDC per name) against the EU, UN, UK and US OFAC sanctions lists. Fuzzy matching; per name a possible-match flag, top score and up to 3 scored matches with their lists. For customer bases, payouts and vendor lists. Costs 0.03 USDC via x402, or 15 credits of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.

names.description: 1 to 25 names separated by ';', e.g. 'Vladimir Putin; Factline'
